title: Rebling Quick Disconnect Plugs – Quick Disconnect T Handle
description: 7017 is identical to Rebling’s 7016 disconnect except the cover length is shorter providing clearance for auxiliary connectors mounted on the battery 7017–1 has a “T” shaped handle while the 7017-2 has a round knob 7017 is a two-wire connector designed to mate with all MS 3509 style (Rebling’s 7002 series) receptacles. It is QPL listed per MS 3349-2 7017 body molded from a chemically resistant and heat resistant plastic. Molded Keyway, embossed body polarity markings and embossed torque values Large contact area of silver-plated copper alloy across socket-receptacle pin interface produces very low electrical losses Low insertion forces and minimal wear on both the shaft and sockets Protective coverings over the socket area are molded from the same heat resistant plastic as the body Self aligning The hardened stainless steel locking screw has been tested to withstand 5000 engagements with the mating receptacle
